contract: Only TransitionLedger may append committed epistemic transitions.
Committed entries are immutable and hash-linked.
Every commit input_state_ref must equal the current deterministic projection.
The ledger recomputes the proposed state delta and rejects output_state_ref mismatch.
Epistemic object IDs are globally immutable and cannot be reused.
Change is represented by creation plus explicit supersession edges, never edit-in-place.
Split and merge are represented by many-to-many supersession topology.
Proof binds the VM decision, verification binds the transition, and replay binds operation plus both state references.
StateProjector is rebuildable from ledger history and cannot commit state.
Audit is a derived read model over ledger entries and has no independent write authority.
